package retry

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type nativeIntervalCase struct {
	Base         int64    `json:"base"`
	Max          int64    `json:"max"`
	Total        int64    `json:"total"`
	CurrentTotal int64    `json:"current_total"`
	Normalized   [3]int64 `json:"normalized"`
	Intervals    []int64  `json:"intervals"`
}

func TestNativeSignedIntervalOracle(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []nativeIntervalCase{
		{Base: math.MaxInt64, Max: math.MaxInt64},
		{Base: 1 << 62, Max: math.MaxInt64, Total: math.MaxInt64, CurrentTotal: math.MaxInt64},
		{Base: 10, Max: 100, Total: 7},
		{Base: -4, Max: 100, Total: -1},
		{Base: 10, Max: -1, Total: 5},
		{Base: 1, Max: 10},
		{Base: math.MinInt64, Max: math.MaxInt64},
		{Base: 1, Max: 1, Total: math.MaxInt64, CurrentTotal: math.MaxInt64},
		{Base: 0, Max: 100},
	}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		bo := InitialBackoffer(time.Duration(c.Base), time.Duration(c.Max), time.Duration(c.Total))
		c.Normalized = [3]int64{int64(bo.base), int64(bo.max), int64(bo.total)}
		bo.currentTotal = time.Duration(c.CurrentTotal)
		for range 5 {
			c.Intervals = append(c.Intervals, int64(bo.nextInterval()))
		}
	}
	require.Equal(t, []int64{math.MaxInt64, -2, -4, -8, -16}, cases[0].Intervals)
	if output := os.Getenv("PD_RETRY_VALUE_ORACLE"); output != "" {
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "intervals.json"), append(data, '\n'), 0600))
	}
}

func TestNativeValueCopyOracle(t *testing.T) {
	original := InitialBackoffer(time.Millisecond, 10*time.Millisecond, 10*time.Millisecond)
	var calls atomic.Int32
	original.SetRetryableChecker(func(error) bool { calls.Add(1); return false }, true)
	original.attempt = 5
	original.next = 3 * time.Millisecond
	original.currentTotal = 4 * time.Millisecond
	original.nextLogTime = 7 * time.Millisecond
	first, second := *original, *original
	require.Equal(t, original.attempt, first.attempt)
	require.Equal(t, original.next, first.next)
	require.Equal(t, original.currentTotal, first.currentTotal)
	require.Equal(t, original.nextLogTime, first.nextLogTime)
	// Replacing the original callback does not replace either copied function.
	original.SetRetryableChecker(nil, true)
	err := errors.New("call")
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for _, bo := range []*Backoffer{&first, &second} {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(bo *Backoffer) {
			defer wg.Done()
			require.ErrorIs(t, bo.Exec(context.Background(), func() error { return err }), err)
		}(bo)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), calls.Load())
	require.Equal(t, 5, original.attempt)
	require.Equal(t, 3*time.Millisecond, original.next)
	require.Equal(t, 4*time.Millisecond, original.currentTotal)
	require.Equal(t, 7*time.Millisecond, original.nextLogTime)
	require.True(t, isBackofferReset(&first))
	require.True(t, isBackofferReset(&second))
}

func TestNativeSignedExecutionOracle(t *testing.T) {
	for _, total := range []time.Duration{0, -1} {
		bo := InitialBackoffer(-1, 100, total)
		calls := 0
		require.NoError(t, bo.Exec(context.Background(), func() error {
			calls++
			if calls < 4 {
				return errors.New("retry")
			}
			return nil
		}))
		require.Equal(t, 4, calls)
		require.True(t, isBackofferReset(bo))
	}
	for _, attempts := range []int{0, -1, -math.MaxInt} {
		require.NoError(t, Retry(context.Background(), attempts, time.Millisecond, func() error { panic("must not execute") }))
	}
	require.Panics(t, func() { _ = Retry(context.Background(), -1, -1, func() error { return nil }) })
	require.Panics(t, func() { _ = Retry(context.Background(), -1, 0, func() error { return nil }) })
	bo := InitialBackoffer(1, 1, 1)
	bo.attempt = math.MaxInt
	observed := 0
	bo.SetRetryableChecker(func(error) bool { observed = bo.attempt; return false }, true)
	require.Error(t, bo.Exec(context.Background(), func() error { return errors.New("done") }))
	require.Equal(t, math.MinInt, observed)
	require.True(t, isBackofferReset(bo))
}

func TestNativeReusableOptionsOracle(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	options := []Option{
		func(bo *Backoffer) {
			require.Equal(t, [3]time.Duration{10, 10, 10}, [3]time.Duration{bo.base, bo.max, bo.total})
			require.Zero(t, bo.logInterval)
			calls++
			bo.SetRetryableChecker(func(error) bool { return false }, true)
		},
		withMinLogInterval(7), withMinLogInterval(11),
		func(bo *Backoffer) {
			require.False(t, bo.isRetryable(errTest))
			bo.SetRetryableChecker(func(error) bool { return true }, false)
			require.False(t, bo.isRetryable(errTest))
		},
	}
	for range 2 {
		bo := InitialBackoffer(100, 10, 1, options...)
		require.Equal(t, time.Duration(11), bo.logInterval)
		require.False(t, bo.isRetryable(errTest))
		require.True(t, isBackofferReset(bo))
	}
	require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
}
